scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed with HCL-derived color harmony across depth levels, a clean typographic hierarchy (header → group labels → leaf filenames → size metadata), and functional breadcrumb navigation — held back from 8 by very tight 2px margins that leave the treemap feeling slightly dense, and leaf label clipping on smaller cells that makes many files unreadable at the overview level.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Area encoding is honest (treemap area ∝ file size via .sum(), zoom correctly swaps scale domains), but PRNG-dependent leaf fill colors violate the permutation invariant and the composite key uses unseparated string concatenation risking collisions.
scores.stress_test_note: No update storm (click-only zoom), interrupt() correctly guards mid-flight transitions, pointer events unify mouse/touch, no cross-view dispatch loops; minor stale-closure risk since mutable x/y scales are referenced inside transition attr callbacks, though rapid-click interrupts mitigate this in practice.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single view with 8 well-chosen Tol colors, depth-based lightness modulation reduces simultaneous categorical load, and the zoom interaction is the primary density relief valve — the root view is dense but structurally legible with clear section boundaries and fitting label suppression.

proposer: 433 → 412 lines (-21). Removed dead `getVisibleNodes` function (defined but never called), eliminated redundant `topNames` alias for `topDirs`, and merged two identical cursor-setting filter blocks into a single `cell.style("cursor", "pointer")`.
